item.title: Alternative Enforcement Program (AEP) - 5-Year Review - Notice of Intent to Request the Release of Funds
item.description:
Management and Budget | Special Materials | Notice In plain English (machine-written): The Office of Management and Budget plans to ask the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development to release $51,780,000 in Community Development Block Grant funds for the citywide Demolition Program over five years.

COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG)

ALTERNATIVE ENFORCEMENT PROGRAM (AEP) 5-YEAR REVIEW - 2026

NOTICE OF INTENT TO REQUEST RELEASE OF FUNDS (NOI RROF)

             

REQUEST FOR RELEASE OF FUNDS

On or about October 8, 2026, the City of New York (the City) anticipates submitting a request to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) for the release of $51,780,000 of Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) funds authorized under the Housing and Community Development Act of 1992, to undertake the Citys Demolition Program citywide, for a period of five years.

The Alternative Enforcement Program (AEP) is intended to address the serious physical deterioration of the most distressed buildings in New York City. Through AEP, the NYC Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) can order the property owner to repair or replace building systems as well as to address violations. item.title: Public Notice of Availability and Notice of Public Hearing
item.description:
Management and Budget | Public Hearings and Meetings | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-10-08 In plain English (machine-written): The Office of Management and Budget will release a plan amendment on Sept. 14, 2026, for $86 million in reallocated federal Hurricane Ida disaster recovery funds and will hold a public hearing Oct. 8, 2026.

COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT PROGRAM - DISASTER RECOVERY

PUBLIC NOTICE OF AVAILABILITY

NOTICE OF A PUBLIC HEARING

 

TO ALL INTERESTED RESIDENTS, GROUPS, COMMUNITY BOARDS, AND AGENCIES:

On Monday, September 14, 2026, the City of New York will release a substantial amendment to its Community Development Block Grant-Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) Action Plan for Hurricane Ida Recovery. Through this amendment, the City will detail its proposed use of $86,000,000 in reallocated CDBG-DR funding provided through the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD).

To access the plan beginning September 14, 2026, please visit: https://www.nyc.gov/site/cdbgdr/hurricane-ida…

item.title: Master service agreements to provide Value Engineering/Value Analysis services (Outreach)
item.description:
Management and Budget | Public Comment on Contract Awards | Notice In plain English (machine-written): The Office of Management and Budget is seeking public comment on two proposed contracts with vendors to provide value engineering studies of a wide range of capital construction projects, running Dec. 1, 2026, through Nov. 30, 2030, with one one-year renewal option.

This is a notice that the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) is seeking comments from the public about the two (2) proposed contracts below.  

 

Contract Type: Contract  

Scope of Services: Master service agreements to provide Value Engineering/Value Analysis services for studies of a wide range of capital construction projects

Term: 12/1/2026 through 11/30/2030 with one (1) one-year renewal option
